I'm designing a motion/"juice" system (animations, shader accents, interaction variants) for Twyne, a Qwik local-first writing app with an AI "room of editors" at /home/diogenes/Projects/apps/twyne. Brand: editorial, letterpress, literary writer's room (paper, ink, stamps, vermilion/cobalt). I need a precise inventory of the **writers' room panels** — the editors (personas), their notes, the rubric/stamp, research — so every component can communicate what it is doing and what an interaction costs. Do not edit anything.

Scope:
- `src/components/editorial-board/editorial-board-overlay.tsx` + `board-tabs.ts`
- `src/components/personas/personas-panel.tsx` (big; grep) and other files in src/components/personas
- `src/components/rubric/*` including `stamp-shader.tsx` and the stamp press (`src/components/ui/stamp-press.tsx`, `workflow-stamp.tsx`) — global.css has `stamp-die-press`, `stamp-ink-settle`, `rubric-proof-settle`, `presswobble` keyframes (~lines 1799-2040)
- `src/components/comments/*`, `src/components/citations/*`
- `src/components/living-desk/*` (living-desk-panel, document-spine, living-desk.css) and `src/utils/living-desk/presence.ts`
- `src/components/instruments/*` (instrument-dock, instrument-room, task-desk, scene-bench, entity-instrument, instrument-art, instrument-motion — note instrument-motion.tsx already defines states rest/open/compare/arrive and a quiet flag)
- `src/components/ui/editorial-loader.tsx`, `application-notice.tsx`, `global-application-toasts.tsx`, `global-connectivity-banner.tsx`, `themed-dialog.tsx`, `text-modal.tsx`, `speak-button.tsx`, `global-speech-player.tsx`, `voice-recorder.tsx`, `live-voice-desk.tsx`
- `src/components/writing-tools/*` if not covered above.

For EACH component/sub-element report compactly:
1. file:line of root JSX and what it shows.
2. Interactions (hover, click, keyboard, drag) and what they do.
3. Current feedback/motion (class names, keyframes, global.css or component .css line numbers), including busy/thinking/waiting, error, success, empty variants. Specifically: how do we show that an editor (persona) is currently reading/thinking? How does a note "arrive"?
4. Consequence class: local-only, sends text to AI provider / spends hosted credits (and where cost or provider is shown), syncs, publishes, destructive.
5. Async lifecycles (queued → running → arrived → accepted/dismissed) and the store fields that represent them — these are hooks I can animate.

Also list the existing reusable motion pieces (keyframes, easing variables, reduced-motion handling, `quiet` mechanisms) so I can reuse rather than duplicate.

Return a structured, terse list with file:line references. Under ~1500 words.

- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 1800000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

content.text:
I mapped every component in scope to file:line references. Five things matter most for your design:

- **No "editor is thinking" state on the portrait in the Cast panel.** `.persona-portrait` only has `data-speaking`, for read-aloud and live voice. While an editor works, the only signals are a text stamp ("thinking…" / "writing…") and an `animate-spin ✦` on the button.
- **The thinking pose exists but the Cast panel never triggers it.** `persona-bust-ponder` (global.css:9765) only fires when a `.persona-note__note` contains `.persona-note__thinking`. That markup is in `editor/persona-note-panel.tsx`, not `personas-panel.tsx`.
- **A note "arrives" by swapping a streaming card for a filed one.** The filed card enters with `feedbackSlide` (0.35s). Replies get a fade-up plus a blinking caret while streaming. There is no stamp or settle moment when a note is filed.
- **The interface shows no per-action cost.** Personas only shows the provider afterwards (`.provider-pill`). Rubric, comments, citations and steering show none. Cost copy exists only in scene-bench, instrument-room/dock, live-voice-desk and `desk/hosted-cost.tsx`.
- **`StampShader` is not imported anywhere.** It is ready to be the "verdict" accent.

---

## Editorial Board overlay
- **Root:** `editorial-board-overlay.tsx:73` `<aside.editorial-overlay>`. Tabs are at :126; the six tabs are defined in `board-tabs.ts:11` with numerals I–VI, each with its own `accent`.
- **Interactions:**
  - Escape closes the board and returns focus to the toggle (:83).
  - Clicking a tab calls `onContext$`.
  - The unread badge `<small>` (:142) reads from `activity[tab.id]`, shown as "9+" above nine.
  - The steering disclosure (:159) holds a `ChatComposer` (:177).
- **Motion:** open/close is a 180ms opacity/transform/visibility transition (global.css:4771). `--closed` is at :4780, the mobile version at :5116, and there is a reduced-motion override. The accent is passed as `--board-accent`/`--context-accent`; the active tab is styled at :4943.
- **Consequence:** steering calls `steerBackgroundResearch` (sends text to the AI and queues a research pass). No cost is shown.
- **Lifecycle:** `steeringBusy` → `steeringNotice` | `steeringError` (:29-35).

## Personas / Cast (`personas-panel.tsx`, 3404 lines)
- **Store:** :139-226. Hooks you can animate:
  - `isGenerating`, `isReplying`, `isMarkingUp`, `isAnalyzing`, `fixingNoteId`
  - `streamingNotes[personaId]`, `streamingReplies[noteId]`, `streamingSynthesis`
  - `lastProvider`, `backgroundRoom.status` (off|armed|idle|reading|error)
  - `decisions[]` (settled), `aiFeedback[traceId]`, `openNoteKey`, `analysisCopiedId`
- **Stream snapshot type:** `GenerationStreamSnapshot` in `utils/generation-stream.ts:15`:
  - `activePart`: reasoning|text|null
  - `status`: running|complete|error
  - `textStatus` and `reasoningStatus`: pending|running|complete
- **Header :1862.** `.provider-pill[data-provider]` (:1881) appears only after a run and shows "fallback" for the local provider.
- **Cast faces :1938.** Clicking opens live voice (`openLiveVoice`, which spends hosted credit). Hover is `translateY(-2px) scale(1.18)`, 180ms, in scoped CSS (:555-575).
- **Action buttons:**

| Button | Line | Function | Busy state |
|---|---|---|---|
| Get notes `.convene-btn` | :1967 | `requestFeedback` :657 | `animate-spin ✦` + "The room is reading…" |
| Propose edits `.markup-btn` | :1984 | `markUpDraft` :1806 | "Proposing…" |
| Full analysis `.room-btn-link` | :2000 | `expandAnalysis` :1080 | "✦ Writing analysis…" |

  All three send the draft to the AI. `requestFeedback` tries BYOK on the client first, then falls back to the hosted Convex service (:812).
- **Background room line :2031.** A `✦` with `animate-pulse` while reading, coloured vermilion (reading), red (error) or muted. The label comes from `backgroundRoomLabel` :3353 (e.g. "after N more words").
- **Waiting with no stream yet :2279.** `EditorialLoader` in compact mode.
- **Streaming card :2306** (`desk-card`, `aria-live`):
  - Uses the same `PersonaMasthead` as the filed card, so nothing shifts on landing.
  - `.desk-card__stamp` shows "thinking…" or "writing…" (:2327).
  - The reasoning `<details>` is at :2337; the body markdown re-renders on every chunk.
  - None of this is animated: only the text changes.
- **Synthesis streaming :2362.** Stamp `--quiet` reading "writing…".
- **Empty state :2382.** The ❦ glyph with copy that changes by `backgroundRoom`.
- **Filed note card :2743.** `article.desk-card.note-card.board-card.feedback-enter` plus `--passing` (background origin) or `--filed`.
  - Settled cards get `is-settled`: opacity .62, back to 1 on hover (global.css:10080).
  - `feedbackSlide` 0.35s translateY(8px) is in scoped CSS at :511, with reduced-motion handled at :520 and global.css:4094.
- **Note keys** (`.board-key`, global.css:6230):
  - Hover scales the svg to 1.12; pressed scales to .92.
  - `[aria-busy]` reuses `persona-reply-dot` (:6272).
  - Keep/Later (`decideNote` :1009) are local and synced.
  - Ask for a fix (:2654, `fixingNoteId`) sends to the AI.
  - 👍/👎 (`submitAiFeedback`) sends telemetry.
  - Talk opens live voice (hosted). `SpeakButton` triggers TTS.
- **Thread :2439.**
  - A streaming reply is `.persona-note__reply.is-streaming`: `persona-reply-enter` 0.32s, `persona-reply-rule` scaleY, and a block caret `persona-reply-caret` (global.css:9690-9725).
  - Before the first token, `.persona-note__thinking` shows three dots (`persona-reply-dot`, :9732-9763).
  - `.is-fresh::before persona-reply-settle` (a glow) is defined at :9707 but the Cast panel never applies it.
- **Reply compose :2517.** The send button (:2580) has `aria-busy` and calls `submitReply` :1251, which sends to the AI.
- **Note sheet :2950.** A native `<dialog>` that closes on backdrop click and returns focus. Open animation `noteSheetIn` is at global.css:6556.
- **Strike the room :2263, `clearRoom` :1849.** Destructive, with no confirmation. It clears notes and manuscript pins.
- **Sub-components:**
  - `persona-portrait.tsx:39` uses `data-speaking` tts|live. `pp-talk` animates `--pp-level` (css:115); hover scales 1.06 (css:164); reduced-motion at :212.
  - `persona-card.tsx:34` has a figure transform transition of 500ms (css:48) and calls live voice at :90.
  - `grounded-note.tsx:112`: clicking a quote reveals it in the manuscript (local).
  - `note-evidence-list.tsx:45`: passage and source jumps.

## Rubric
- **Store:** `rubric-panel.tsx:105`. Fields: `isAnalyzing` (writer-initiated), `isReviewing` (quiet/automatic), `resultFresh`, `judges[]`, `judgesFingerprint` against `result.draftFingerprint` (stale notes), `isSuggesting`, `status`, `error`.
- **Lifecycle:** analyze at :267 → snapshot revision (:337) → judgement pass → client judges (:400) → `resultFresh` → `playRubricGradeCue` (an audio cue, :752). `autoReadRoom` :765 is triggered by the live-review snapshot (:849).
- **Render:**
  - Empty state with "Grade this draft" (:1018, sends to the AI).
  - `EditorialLoader` while analyzing (:1048).
  - Verdict `.rubric-proof` plus `--fresh` (:1066).
  - `GradeStamp animated={resultFresh} impressionKey={timestamp}` (:1073).
  - Section tabs (:1147). The Editors tab shows "reading…" / "soon" (:1178).
  - "Ask them now" (:1261) and "Grade again" (:1306) both send to the AI.
  - Sparkline (:1342) and delta badge ▲/▼ (:1393).
  - The criteria editor's "suggest" (`isSuggesting`) sends to the AI.
- **Stamp press:**
  - `ui/stamp-press.tsx:12` adds `.ink-stamp--pressing` only after the walnut die image loads.
  - Keyframes, all 500ms linear: `stamp-die-press` (global.css:1939), `stamp-ink-settle` (:1970), `stamp-contact-shadow` (:1992). The press is wired at :1842-1850.
  - `rubric-proof-settle` is 380ms (:1798/:1927). `rubric-fill` is 0.6s (:2030).
  - Reduced-motion: :2011 and :4091.
- **Other stamp pieces:**
  - `grade-stamp.tsx:24` sets tier rotation (a/b/c/revise) and a `--highest` flag for A+.
  - `workflow-stamp.tsx:10` covers "filed" and "revised".
